t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different gnomes give different amount of mushrooms according to the colour of the gnome. It is worth seeing how many mushrooms you get when it is x1. The same colour gnomes always appear together so you can compare each colour against each other but best to do this when it is x1 and not x5. You need to make good decisions, but don't be too slow. Stretch hands when taking a break.

vb_textbox.text: It seems as though different colour gnomes give you different numbers of points. They appear in the same colour pairs each time - pink and brown, orange and purple, green and blue and yellow and red. You can test which ones give more points - the best time to test is when it is x1 points. It seemed that gnomes which often gave high points would sometimes give low points. I think the number of points a gnome gives might have something to do with which side it is on. The colour pairs of gnomes keep switching sides. I did not manage to keep track of which side each gnome would give higher points but it might be something to try. Also, I wondered if there was a pattern in how many points a particular gnome awarded on successive appearances but I did not get to test this. There is not much time to think so generally if a particular gnome often gives high points when it is x5 it is best to go with that gnome.
